'''Brett Kitani''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Tempe tournament (25 June)]] on 25 June 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Huntdown]], according to Michael Girard's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d941">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-tempe-az-6-25-00d941/ tempe-az-6-25-00], DeckTech (Michael "Dvader" Girard, 26 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-26-tempe-az-6-25-00d941/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
